title: ModernWarfare to the Max
description: Modern combat pushed to the limit — realistic weapons, tactical gameplay, survival mechanics, and high-intensity warfare.
body:
This modpack puts together loads of content mods, optimization mods, and QoL mods to create the perfect modern warfare experience. Includes guns through TaCZ, vehicles, cannons, mortars, and more through SuperbWarfare, tech through Mekanism, Ballistix, and Ad Astra, and custom scripting through Kubejs to tie it all together. 
Bobby Reforged mod found on curseforge here https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bobby-reforged
